android.desc: Wakie is the social app where you can feel safe talking to new people who eventually may turn into your real friends. Talk through any topic or start a free phone call with people all over the world. Whether you want to get rid of boredom, practice a foreign language, or even share your personal experience and problems.  CREATE AND DISCOVER ENGAGING TOPICS – Browse the Live Feed to find discussions that pique your interest. – Start your own thread in our vibrant group chat sessions and attract participants who share your passions. You can even initiate a group live chat to meet new people within interest-based spaces. – Use the Carousel feature to discover active community members based on topics and profiles that interest you. Swipe through to find people you’d like to connect with. FLEXIBLE CHAT OPTIONS – Choose to connect through voice calls, messages, or voice messages based on your preferences. – All connections happen through user profiles or structured topic spaces and require mutual confirmation. A SAFE PLACE WHERE YOU CAN BE YOUR TRUE SELF – Enjoy freedom in how you present yourself with customizable nicknames and profile options while maintaining a persistent account identity. – Rest assured that our community is monitored around the clock, fostering a safe space free from discrimination and inappropriate behavior. – Sometimes, the best advice comes from someone new. Share your thoughts openly and discover new friends who might just have the insight you need. CELEBRATE AND REWARD ENGAGING CONVERSATIONS – Send colorful stickers and special gifts to acknowledge meaningful interactions. – Receive tokens of appreciation from others, which can lead to lasting friendships and further discussions. DEEPEN YOUR CONNECTIONS IN SPECIAL INTEREST CLUBS – Join one of thousands of clubs that cater to a variety of interests, from gaming to language learning, or even start your own. – Find group chat rooms where you can engage in deeper conversations with like-minded individuals in moderated community spaces. ENHANCE YOUR EXPERIENCE WITH WAKIE PLUS – Customize your profile with exclusive badges and background colors. – Promote your discussions to ensure they reach a broader audience. – Enjoy advanced features like seeing who visited your profile and revisiting past topics with ease.
